title: Urutonde rwo kwisuzuma – Atomi na molekile
subject: Kemi
intro: Uru rutonde rukurikiza intambwe z'ingenzi z'igitabo cyo kwiga. Shyira akamenyetso ku byo wumva ufitiye icyizere, intambwe ku yindi. Ibyo mu gice cya Kwimbika ni iby'ushaka kujya kure kurushaho.

sections.title: 1. Ibintu byose bigizwe n'atomi (M1)
items: Nzi ko ibintu byose bigizwe n'atomi.
Nshobora kuvuga amazina y'ibice bitatu bigize atomi no kuvuga umuriro buri gice gifite.
Nzi aho protoni, neitoroni na elegitoroni ziherereye mu atomi.
Nshobora gusobanura impamvu atomi nta muriro ifite (protoni zingana na elegitoroni).
Kwimbika: Nzi ko urwego rw'inyuma ari rwo rugena uko atomi yihuza n'izindi, kandi ko urwego rw'imbere rwakira elegitoroni 2 naho urukurikiraho rukakira 8.

sections.title: 2. Ibintu fatizo n'ibimenyetso bya shimi (M2)
items: Nzi icyo ikintu fatizo ari cyo.
Nzi icyo numero ya atomike bivuga.
Nzi ibimenyetso bya hidrogene, kaboni, nitrogène, oksijeni na kolori (H, C, N, O, Cl).
Nzi amaboko (amasano) ari kuri hidrogene (1), oksijeni (2), nitrogène (3), kaboni (4) na kolori (1).

sections.title: 3. Molekile – iyo atomi zifatanye (M3)
items: Nzi icyo molekile n'isano ya shimi ari cyo.
Nshobora gutandukanya isano imwe, isano ebyiri n'isano eshatu, kandi nkazishushanya nk'imirongo.
Nzi izina, formule ya molekile n'imiterere y'isano bya gaze hidrogene (H₂), gaze oksijeni (O₂), gaze nitrogène (N₂) na gaze kolori (Cl₂).
Nshobora gusobanura impamvu gaze hidrogene ari H₂ aho kuba H gusa.
Kwimbika: Nzi impamvu amagaze adakora nka heliyumu aboneka ari atomi imwe imwe.

sections.title: 4. Ibinyabutabire (M4)
items: Nzi icyo ikinyabutabire ari cyo kandi nshobora gutanga ingero.
Nshobora gutandukanya ikintu fatizo (O₂), ikinyabutabire (H₂O) n'imvange (umwuka).
Nzi izina, formule ya molekile n'imiterere y'isano by'amazi (H₂O) na dioksidi ya kaboni (CO₂).
Nzi imiterere y'amazi, dioksidi ya kaboni, amoniyaki na metani (igoramye, igororotse, piramide, tetrahedron).

sections.title: 5. Formule – ururimi rwa shimi (M5)
items: Nshobora gusobanura icyo umubare muto hasi (indisi) bivuga: umubare w'atomi muri molekile.
Nshobora gusobanura icyo umubare munini imbere ya formule (koefisiyenti) bivuga: umubare wa molekile.
Nshobora kubara atomi z'ubwoko bwose ziri muri 3 H₂O, urugero (6 H na 3 O).
Nzi ko umuntu adahinduranya umubare muto hasi kugira ngo abone molekile nyinshi.
Nshobora gutandukanya H, 2 H, H₂ na 2 H₂.

sections.title: 6. Ibikorwa bya shimi (M6)
items: Nzi icyo igikorwa cya shimi ari cyo kandi nshobora kugitandukanya n'ihinduka rya fiziki.
Nzi icyo reyaktante n'ibivuyemo ari cyo.
Nzi ko atomi zitigera zishira cyangwa ngo zivuke, ahubwo zihindura gusa abo zifatanye.
Nshobora kugenzura ko formule y'igikorwa iringaniye mbara atomi ku mpande zombi.
Nshobora kuringaniza 2 H₂ + O₂ → 2 H₂O no gusobanura buri ntambwe.
Kwimbika: Nshobora kuringaniza gutwika metani no kuvuka kwa amoniyaki.
